en: The image shows a black-and-white or sepia-toned postcard view of a riverbank lined with trees and historic buildings. A large religious building with a prominent clock tower is visible to the right, partly obscured by trees. Across the river, there are traditional European-style houses. The water reflects the buildings and trees, contributing to a picturesque and tranquil scene. The postcard features printed text in German in red ink at the top.
